DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

Given the classic history of position-dependent vertigo and the normal Videonystagmography except for a positive Dix-Hallpike response, the diagnosis is established. I would recommend canalith repositioning maneuvers (Epley maneuver) for treatment.
